title: X6840B-16.2.0.140SP10-OP008PF001AZ-16.3.0.140SP09-OP004PF001AZ_20260724115026
description:
It is recommended to perform OTA upgrade when the battery is over 50%.

Update Version:
X6840B-16.3.0.140SP09(OP004PF001AZ)

Changed Functions:
- Updated Google Security Patch to August 1, 2026.

AI Suggestions
- Added TikTok content recommendations to Dynamic Bar, making it easier to discover trending videos in real time.
- Added intelligent Lazada parcel tracking, so you can view delivery progress at a glance.
- Upgraded travel management across scenarios with support for international and intercity travel cards that intelligently show itinerary information based on changes in your location.

Smoothness
- Streamlined system services by rebuilding core services to reduce power consumption, improve performance, extend battery life, and make operation smoother.
- Enhanced cleanup capabilities with deeper system junk scanning to free up storage more precisely.

Fixed Issues:
Smoothness
- Fixed stuttering in scenarios such as swiping in camera preview, persistent notification pop-ups, and video recording for smoother operation.
- Optimized smoothness when switching between apps, swiping on Zero Screen for the first time, and browsing mainstream social media apps for smoother animations.
- Fixed issues with stuttering in the unlock animation and lag when loading pop-ups after tapping an unconnected Wi-Fi network, improving responsiveness.

Stability
- Improved system module robustness and running reliability in complex memory scenarios and during long, intensive use.
- Optimized fingerprint and face unlock for better stability and higher unlock success rates.

Camera
- Optimized camera launch transitions for smoother, more natural preview loading, making it easier to capture the moment.
- Improved image quality for indoor shooting.

AI Gallery
- Fixed issues in AI Gallery where Memories albums could fail to open properly, background music could fail to play, sub-albums could show a white screen, and full-resolution images could fail to load properly.
- Fixed issues where image covers could load incompletely, transparent animated images could display abnormal backgrounds, and some new photos could be sorted by time inaccurately.

Notifications
- Fixed issues where email push notifications could fail to arrive and notifications could become unresponsive when tapped after multiple incorrect password attempts on the lock screen.
- Fixed touch response issues in parts of the notification bar for more responsive interactions.

AI Assistant
- Fixed issues where the voice assistant could fail to execute some commands on the lock screen and could stop responding after switching AI models.

Battery
- Optimized thermal management and performance during gaming for a more comfortable experience during extended play.

Privacy & Security
- Updated Google Security Patch to August 2026 for enhanced system security.

Reminding:
1. Optimized system stability and performance while fixing other issues.
2. Visit the XClub forum (https://www.infinix.club) for more information.
